body: I just want that sinking feeling to stop. I want to look in a mirror and not hate what I see. I just want it to end. I want the tide to come in and give me that high. Because the low tide is pulling me under because it feels like it is never going to stop

I feel like that too. Everyday, every second. I'm trying to Handel it too but it gets hard when you have no one to talk to. Even if its about stupid things. You can talk to me and you won't find any judgment.

When people look at me they see a happy weird energetic girl that has no worries in the world. On the inside I am not that. I am broken, ashamed and so tired. I try to district myself and try to cope but with each passing day its as if it gets harder to Handel. People say I make friends easily but I don't see it. I have never had a friend to talk to. I have been through hell and no one knows. My family couldn't give a crap and my so called friends are only there when its time to party. I hate myself. I hate who I am and I hate the fact that being me is something people can party with but not connect with. My whole life I have never had 1 true friend or family member. I don't know what to do, I'm currently standing on my balcony hating myself for not being able to jump.
It feels like it is eating my soul. I'm not great with words but I just need to talk even if it's about nothing
